DELETE FROM  [ReconControl].dbo.tbl_FCM_GMI_Fee_Recon_ST4_NFA
WHERE MONTH(create_Dte) = MONTH(GETDATE())
AND YEAR(create_Dte) = YEAR(GETDATE())

SELECT  cast(COUNT(*) as int) as ActualRowsLoaded
from dbo.tbl_FCM_GMI_Fee_Recon_ST4_NFA
where cast(create_dte as date) = cast(getdate() as date)

DELETE FROM  [ReconControl].dbo.tbl_FCM_GMI_Fee_Recon_GL_NFA
WHERE MONTH(create_Dte) = MONTH(GETDATE())
AND YEAR(create_Dte) = YEAR(GETDATE())

SELECT  cast(COUNT(*) as int) as ActualRowsLoaded
from dbo.tbl_FCM_GMI_Fee_Recon_GL_NFA
where cast(create_dte as date) = cast(getdate() as date)

select  [itemId], [effDate], riskMonth, [rc],[co], [dda], [subAccount],[name1],[description],[balancePool], [entryDate],[riskDate],[currency],[dr] ,[cr],[amount],[amtOrig], [create_dt]  from [kpikriReporting].[dbo].[tbl_lvlThreeDetail_GL]  where rc  = '0010842'  and dda = '4402998' and co = '00037' 
and entryDate >= (cast(DATEADD(m,-1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(m,0,getdate()), 0)) as date)) and 
(entryDate < cast (Dateadd(dd, -Datepart(dd, Getdate()) + 1, Getdate()) as DATE)) and 
cast(effDate as date) = cast('5/31/2021' as date) union select  [itemId], [effDate], riskMonth, [rc],[co], [dda], [subAccount],[name1],[description],[balancePool], [entryDate],[riskDate],[currency],[dr] ,[cr],[amount],[amtOrig], [create_dt]  from [kpikriReporting].[dbo].[tbl_lvlThreeDetail_GL]  where rc  = '0198086'  and dda = '4402882' and co = '00037' 
and entryDate >= (cast(DATEADD(m,-1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(m,0,getdate()), 0)) as date)) and 
(entryDate < cast (Dateadd(dd, -Datepart(dd, Getdate()) + 1, Getdate()) as DATE)) and 
cast(effDate as date) = cast('5/31/2021' as date)
